system.description:
Kishai Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Uncommon, Air. 1 item slot.

Prerequisites: Power[2]

A thickly woven net of grass fibers. It is about 10ft to a side, and the corners are tied with heavy stones.

Throw Net (Action): When you have this net equipped in both hands, you can throw it a distance up to 5Xft (where X is your Power Score). From a square that distance away, select a 10ft x 10ft square. All creature in that space make Power Checks against your Check DC against 3 levels of Pin. If a creature takes any levels of Pin and are a flying creature, they cannot fly provided they have any levels of Pin this way. You may use the net once per quick rest.

Rulebook p.77.
